prompts.a: Use case: stylized-concept. Production raster asset atlas for Bagseed character customization. Reference image is STYLE ONLY: match the warm hand-illustrated CHIBI faces of the PLAYER and REMY in the Bagseed pose-review sheet, rounded soft cheeks, compact round chin, large warm eyes, thick clean brown outline, warm painterly shading. Create NEW HEAD ART, not a review page. Exactly TEN equal-height rows and FOUR equal-width columns, absolutely no labels, no text, no grid. Columns: front, strict right profile facing RIGHT, back, strict left profile facing LEFT. In each row the SAME tan-skinned young adult head with the SAME friendly round face and identical anatomical proportions in all four views; only hairstyle changes by row. Skin #cf9670; hair neutral medium chocolate #4a2c1a, dark brown eyes. Heads ONLY with tiny bare neck stub: NO shoulders, NO chest, NO clothing, no hands or accessories. Preserve a round chibi head, broad forehead and short jaw; avoid realistic elongated faces or angular anime chin. Hair MUST be completely drawn and naturally end in tapered strands; long hair extends below the neck with transparent space through the center below the neck so a torso can be layered there. Generous empty gutters between all 40 cells, no overlapping rows, center neck stubs consistently in columns, never crop hair. Exact row order: 1. short tousled rounded crop; 2. buzzcut; 3. medium ear-length layered hair; 4. long straight hair reaching below shoulders, complete tapered ends; 5. chin-length bob; 6. voluminous rounded curls; 7. long loose waves reaching below shoulders, complete ends; 8. high single bun; 9. low ponytail, entire tail visible; 10. two long braids, complete ends. Transparent background with true alpha. Target high-resolution portrait atlas 2048x3072 or largest supported size. Cohesive professional game components, crisp finished linework and detailed strands, matching the reference's established chibi cast, not flat vector, not pixels, not a diagram.
